verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI gateway, since one could plausibly offer a batch API for many requests at once. The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-operation capability. Exporting a filtered log list as CSV/JSON is an adjacent observability feature, not a bulk operation across items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
